count_unit: per character / source / trigger or branch; aliases of a released skill are counted once

ultimate_burst_shortlist.priority: Team ultimate-opened damage windows first, including enemy vulnerability; personal windows are separate and shared-SP battle-release bonuses are secondary.
ultimate_burst_shortlist.boundary: Individual ultimate energy and animation still matter; subsequent battle attacks retain their SP costs. No orchestration is implemented.

categories.first_ultimate_burst_candidate: Use an identified successful ultimate release; exact native frame is outside this model contract.
categories.later_battle_release: Shared-SP battle-release bonuses are secondary to the requested ultimate burst shortlist.
categories.conditional_current_target: Calculate only with explicit current hit target predicates; missing input stays unknown.
categories.confirmed_native_fragment_only: Confirmed fragment/outcome and recipient/lifetime required; no automatic cast mapping.
categories.deferred_identified_combo: Keep master combo handling; anonymous E does not identify owner or skill.
categories.deferred_attribute_input: Verified formula needs actual native attribute-domain input, not final panel substitution.
categories.deferred_producer: Existing formula does not prove hit/outcome/field/count or cleanup production.
